changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment SET jhi_link = regexp_replace(jhi_link, '^.*/', '') WHERE jhi_link LIKE '%/%' AND jhi_link NOT LIKE '/%' AND jhi_link NOT LIKE '%://%'
UPDATE attachment SET jhi_link = SUBSTRING_INDEX(jhi_link, '/', -1) WHERE jhi_link LIKE '%/%' AND jhi_link NOT LIKE '/%' AND jhi_link NOT LIKE '%://%'
